section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study (Study X) conducted in Portugal. The sample consisted of 369 women from the general population, aged 18-55 years (M = 26.84), with a mean BMI of 23.21 kg/m² (normal weight range). The BMI distribution of the sample was comparable to the female Portuguese population.
